title: A check that examined nothing does not report a pass
description: Every scan, filter or audit states what it looked at, so an empty result can be told from an empty subject.
statement: A check that found no files, no nodes or no candidates must say so and exit non-zero or `undetermined` — never 0 with a clean report. Assert a non-vacuity floor alongside the property itself.
rationale: Measured repeatedly in this repository: `check-declared-assets` reported 0 findings over 45 dead links; `check-agents-xref` printed a census of 0 where it had been 8, at exit 0; `bean-store-hygiene` asserted over an empty list; ruff reported a clean baseline over missing paths. The verified count of this defect in one session was eight.
